blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – House prosecution panel member and Manila Rep. Joel Chua on Saturday drew a comparison between the impeachment conviction of Chief Justice Renato Corona over undisclosed assets and the unexplained wealth allegations against Vice President Sara Z. Duterte, which a prosecution expert said could allegedly reach P1.5 billion. Chua pointed out that Corona was removed from office in 2012 over assets involving a much smaller amount, as he questioned how Duterte’s defense would explain the financial discrepancies raised in her impeachment trial. “In comparison doon kay former Chief Justice Renato Corona, ang napatunayan lamang po doon is more or […]...
